notes: Both 'even's are added under rule 16's limit: each stands before an appositional phrase that no object marker marks — the first before a לְ phrase that already holds its own 'to', the second before 'the cities of the land', the clause's markers standing back on מַמְלֶכֶת. Neither is rule 16's 'even unto' extent expression, since neither preposition is a limit preposition whose object the word introduces.
The italic 'their' before 'borders' is added: no suffix or other possessive morpheme stands in the phrase (rule 18's closing sentence).

Article counts run phrase by phrase: הָאֱמֹרִי and הָאָרֶץ are the arthrous case where nothing is fronted, while הַבָּשָׁן's article is unrepresented because the ASV writes 'king of Bashan' bare (rule 29).
